focus: جلسه ششم · پرسیدن و گفتن دارایی

sentences.fa: در رو قفل کنم؟ من کلید ندارم؛ می خوام لباسمو عوض کنم.
sentences.en: Shall I lock the door? I haven't got a key; I would like to change my clothes.
Life is great, I have got everything.

sentences.fa: جاي خالي توو لاکر بالا سرم ندارم، چمدونم رو کجا بذارم.
sentences.en: There isn't any space in the locker over my head, where shall I put my case?

sentences.fa: مي خوايي اينجا بموني يا همراهم بيايي؟
sentences.en: Would you like to stay here or come with me?

sentences.fa: شام رو بيرون بخوريم؟ شام ندارم.
sentences.en: Shall we eat dinner out? I haven't got dinner.

sentences.fa: يه سري اطلاعات در مورد شهريه تون مي خوام.
sentences.en: I would like some information about your tuitions.
I haven't got any information, what shall I say?

sentences.fa: شطرنج بلد نيستم، تخته نرد بازي کنيم؟
sentences.en: I can't play chess, shall we play backgammon?
What shall we play?
What shall I play with?

sentences.fa: مي خوايي با چي بازي کني؟
sentences.en: What would you like to play with?
Life is terrible, I haven't got any thing.
Can you play sport?
Which sports can your mother play?

sentences.fa: يسري اطلاعات در مورد تورهاي تفريحي تون مي خوام.
sentences.en: I would like some information about your excursions.

sentences.fa: جا توو سالن هست؟ مي خوام بشينم.
sentences.en: Are there any seats in the salon? I would like to sit.
Where shall I seat?
Would you like to sit here?
What kind of car have you got?

sentences.fa: پدرت ماشين نداره، مي خوايي با من بيايي؟
sentences.en: Your father hasn't got a car, would you like to come with me?
Shall I come with you?
I am broke, I haven't got anything.

sentences.fa: پدرم يسري مشکلات داره، پارتي داري براش؟
sentences.en: My father has got some problems, have you got any contacts for him?
What can you cook?

sentences.fa: همه چي بلدم بپزم، برات اسپاگتي بپزم؟
sentences.en: I can cook everything; shall I cook spaghetti for you?

sentences.fa: يسري اطلاعات در باره پروازهاي نيمه شبتون مي خوام.
sentences.en: I would like some information about red eyes.

sentences.fa: مادرت توو ايران قوم و خويشي داره؟
sentences.en: Has your mother got any relatives in Iran?
How many brothers have you got?
We haven't got any children, what shall we do?

sentences.fa: مي خوام ميز رو بچينم، ليوان و بشقابي سر ميز نيست.
sentences.en: I would like to set the table; there aren't any glasses or plates on the table.
Shall I serve the dinner?
They haven't got anything, what shall I order?

sentences.fa: مي خواي غذا دريايي سفارش بدي؟
sentences.en: Would you like to order sea food?

sentences.fa: اين دور و برا هتلي هست؟
sentences.en: Is there any hotel near here?

sentences.fa: اين دور و برا پمپ بنزيني هست؟
sentences.en: Is there a petrol station near here?
I would like to fill up the tank.

sentences.fa: بنزين نداري، سر راه بنزين بزنم؟
sentences.en: You haven't got any petrol; shall I fill up the tank on the way?

sentences.fa: مي شه بعد از من تکرار نکني؟
sentences.en: Could you not repeat after me?
What shall I do?

sentences.fa: مي شه سرو صدا نکني؟ مي خوام يه چرتي بزنم.
sentences.en: Could you not make noise? I would like to take a nap.
You look sleepy.
Would you like to take a nap?
Has your brother got a wife?
Have you got a job?
Have you got any questions?
Shall we start?
Let's start.
I haven't got any questions.
Shall I ask you?
I haven't got any questions, let's start.

words.fa: پروازهاي نيمه شب ( از ساعت 1 تا 4 نيمه شب)
